summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for plug and socket connector pair, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The plug/jack form identifies a detachable mating connection with two corresponding sides. The conductor path passes through a defined pin interface; plug name, socket name and mating references remain necessary for practical wiring.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Verify the pin-view convention on both halves.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A detachable connector interface differs from a permanent splice or a terminal bridge.
